My story

I survived my own lifestyle.

  1. AGE 37Running on empty.

    Late nights at work, meals on the run, caffeine and stress. I woke up more tired than when I went to bed.

  2. YEARS OF MISTAKESA small fortune for nothing.

    I bought one supplement after another. I had no idea that the form and the time of day matter more than the brand.

  3. TURNING POINTBiochemistry, not advertising.

    I started studying mineral forms, extracts and the body's daily rhythm. I changed how I eat and sleep, too. Little by little, I started to feel different.

Apothelix is exactly the set of plans I put together for myself. So you don't have to repeat my mistakes.
